recommended_solution: Increase contrast between foreground text and background. Check applicable WCAG contrast requirements.
explanation: Low contrast can make text difficult to read.

recommended_solution: Increase target dimensions or spacing and verify applicable WCAG target-size requirements.
explanation: Small interactive targets can be difficult to activate.

recommended_solution: Provide visible, programmatically associated labels for inputs.
explanation: Labels clarify what users should enter.

recommended_solution: Provide meaningful text alternatives for informative images; mark decorative images appropriately.
explanation: Text alternatives help users understand non-text content.

recommended_solution: Ensure interactive controls are operable by keyboard and focus is visible.
explanation: Keyboard support helps users who cannot use a pointer.

recommended_solution: Identify errors in text and provide actionable correction guidance.
explanation: Specific error feedback helps users recover.

recommended_solution: Use consistent navigation order and labels across repeated pages.
Add a descriptive, unique page title.
explanation: A clear title helps users understand the page context.
